provenanceRules: Anchors must be literal substrings of the exported original question prompt or answer explanation.
Question prompt supports proposed structure, but automatic approval is forbidden.
Bank explanation and answer are source claims, not independent mathematical proof.
External image paths and alt text cannot certify diagram content.
No fabricated mastery evidence, no arbitrary tie breaker, and no curriculum verdict without reviewer.
Holdout questions already inspected: use fresh unseen holdout for any later tuning evaluation.

rules.purpose: Identify known initial amount, change, final amount, and requested unknown separately.
rules.reviewGate: Ambiguity can be resolved only after explicit verified role mapping.

rules.purpose: Distinguish known whole / missing part from known parts / missing whole.
rules.constraint: A part-whole picture mentioned in text is not by itself a verified image.
rules.reviewGate: No automatic method substitution; compare candidates to grounded roles.

rules.purpose: Separate repeated cycle, growing differences, adjacent-term recurrence, and spatial-rule pyramids.
rules.constraint: A sequence label or increasing bottom row does not prove the overall pyramid rule.
rules.reviewGate: Require actual rule evidence; defer if multiple rules fit.

rules.purpose: Separate data provided as a plain list, table, picture graph, or bar chart.
rules.constraint: Do not infer the presence of a graph/table from topic title or method family.
rules.reviewGate: Unverified external graphic blocks visual-specific proof.

rules.purpose: Track front/back ordinal positions, before/after, inclusive counts and overlap.
rules.constraint: Position indexing is not automatically logical elimination.
rules.reviewGate: Check off-by-one and inclusive counting in explanation.

rules.purpose: Identify counted objects, size, and distinct legal placements in grids or drawings.
rules.constraint: Grid dimensions in text can support counts; external shape pixels still require inspection.
rules.reviewGate: Visual highlighting is deferred to diagram engine.

rules.purpose: Require accessible and visually inspected media before diagram-accuracy certification.
rules.constraint: File paths, alt text and answer keys are not independent pixel verification.
rules.reviewGate: Keep method-fit proposal tentative and visual verdict unverified.

rules.purpose: Assess concept and representation appropriateness for stated primary level and enrichment context.
rules.constraint: Mathematical correctness does not establish grade-level pedagogical suitability.
rules.reviewGate: Require human curriculum lead decision; do not relabel question automatically.

rules.purpose: Distinguish portions of original whole, changed whole, fraction left and multistep dependencies.
rules.constraint: Correct answer in source is not an independently verified worked solution.
rules.reviewGate: Do not reward method without verified base of each fraction.

rules.purpose: Trace equal fractions of different wholes, ratio units, scale factors and changing quantities.
rules.constraint: A ratio-looking word problem can require more than one method.
rules.reviewGate: Keep multiple methods ambiguous until unit interpretation confirmed.

rules.purpose: State assumption of constant total work and uniform worker rates for inverse-rate methods.
rules.constraint: Method may be mathematically valid but needs separate curriculum appropriateness.
rules.reviewGate: Do not merge this into the speed-distance formula by name alone.

rules.purpose: Track measurement units, required remaining quantity, and time-offset direction.
rules.constraint: Do not classify a clock that is fast as a positive elapsed-time addition.
rules.reviewGate: Diagrams and units still require separate inspection.
